output.summary: A family of perennial flowering herbs found in tropical and subtropical America, Africa and Asia, especially the American tropics. Its flowers have a distinctive, one-time rapid movement that transfers pollen when triggered by a pollinator.
output.edibilityNote: Maranta arundinacea provides arrowroot starch; flowers of two Calathea species are cooked, and C. allouia has an edible tuber.
